gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-noto-ser: Love Ya Like A Sister glides along like a single drawn wire, low-slung, with its terminals flicking outward. But Noto Serif Yezidi moves in gently tapered strokes, and its words pack into solid blocks.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-odor-mea: Loud, low and loose-limbed: Love Ya Like A Sister draws each stroke like a pipe, with ascenders that barely rise. And Odor Mean Chey answers in tall, rounded serif forms whose squeezed mouths give the pair its dignity.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-pt-serif: PT Serif Caption has a tall x-height you notice at once, with slightly thinned joins where curves meet stems. Love Ya Like A Sister's constant-ink stripe sits above it.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-suez-one: Wide-open letters on top, tighter ones below. Love Ya Like A Sister is at its best with smooth, unpinched, flare-free strokes, while Suez One gets its bookish refinement from tall bowls and thin channels into each counter.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-lora: Lora is the text serif here, with a broad c and hairline thinning. Love Ya Like A Sister sits lower in the lowercase, so you could give Lora a little more size to even them out.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-merriweathe: Merriweather feels cozy, its tall middle band making each line look stocky. Love Ya Like A Sister never swells like brush lettering, while the text serif body plays a restrained thick-thin game, like a worn wooden stamp.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-archivo: Lugrasimo writes a loose, spread-out line with a hand-drawn feel and mellow modulation, and Archivo opens its curves outward beneath it. Reading on goes down smoothly.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-author: Author reads refined and dignified, a slight swell on its bowls making every serif line feel considered. Lugrasimo's hand-drawn warmth is the pair's real charm.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk reads clean and approachable, with no thick-and-thin modulation, so even its g is one unchanging line. But Lugrasimo's brushy, half-turned contrast gives the pair its friendly spark.
gen-gf-lugrasimo-crimson-pro: Lugrasimo brings a hand-drawn, spread-out looseness, with no ink pooling where curves turn in. And Crimson Pro, close-packed and subtly modulated, can stay modest in size since its open shapes carry well.
